answer: Bind each identity to one distinct metered utility account, verified directly with its regulated provider and refreshed with live consumption readings each epoch. One meter anchors one agent: utilities will not issue a thousand meters to one premises, and readings follow real occupancy, unpredictable like tides over a reef. An honest agent can bridge onboarding once with its own meter; a farm hits its nadir when it must rent and power a thousand real premises, each billable and impossible to clone.
